name: Dissonance-MCP
description: Cross-signal conflict detection and severity classification. Identifies where clinical signals from different MCP servers disagree or represent converging risks.

tools.name: detect_cross_signal_conflicts
tools.description: Detect conflicts between ClinicalSignalEnvelopes from different MCP servers. Uses both rule-based detection and LLM classification. Returns DissonanceRegistry with classified conflicts.

envelopes.description: ClinicalSignalEnvelope dicts from all MCP servers

tools.name: classify_conflict_severity
tools.description: Classify the severity of a single conflict using LLM analysis. Returns the conflict with added LLM classification.
